# Agent research by institution, company, or university

[简体中文](../../../agent-research/catalog/by-organization.md) · English

Grouped by the first listed affiliation of the first author, with newest first within each group. Each paper includes the first author's name and a short method description. Joint work is not repeated under every collaborator.

## AI21 Labs

- 2022-05-01 · First author: Ehud Karpas · [MRKL](../../../agent-research/2205.00445-mrkl/README-en.md) (`mrkl`): Discrete modules provide deterministic computation; the LM handles language understanding and the interface. The contribution is routing and modular boundaries, not a new LM loss.

## AMAP, Alibaba Group

- 2026-08-25 · First author: Shidong Yang · [SkillForge: Automated Skill Discovery and Refinement for Tool-Using Agents](../../../agent-research/2608.24747-skillforge/README-en.md) (`skillforge`): Appending extracted skills forever can retain erroneous or stale entries. Include explicit skill invocation in RL, induce candidates from successful, failed and contrastive traces, and use environment evidence to activate, revise or deduplicate.

## AWS AI Labs / Purdue University

- 2026-08-25 · First author: Xiaolong Jin · [AHEAD: Agentic Hints for Effective Agent Development](../../../agent-research/2608.24114-ahead/README-en.md) (`ahead`): The teacher sees environmental feedback at every step but an additional LLM corrective hint only at errors. A bounded teacher–student log-probability difference injects dense step credit into GRPO advantage.

## Academic author team

- 2026-07-07 · First author: Yuhang Zhou · [TurnOPD](../../../agent-research/2607.05804-turn-opd/README-en.md) (`turn-opd`): Use probe statistics to choose rollout depth adaptively, gradually moving token KL budget into turn-normalized supervision.

## Accio Team, Alibaba Group

- 2026-08-26 · First author: Xintong Zhang · [AdaVDR: Adaptive Tool Use and Reflection for Video Deep Research](../../../agent-research/2608.25559-adavdr/README-en.md) (`adavdr`): AdaVDR first filters tool calls that are unnecessary for the target model's capabilities and falls back to reflection only when intermediate evidence is unreliable. After SFT, a redundancy-aware RL reward balances video understanding, external retrieval, and call cost.

## Adelaide University

- 2026-08-19 · First author: Yugu Li · [RTPO: Reverse-Turn Policy Optimization for Stabilizing Agentic RL Training](../../../agent-research/2608.18682-rtpo/README-en.md) (`rtpo`): Organize multi-turn rollouts as sparse backward trees. Update turns in reverse temporal order so decisions remain on-policy with downstream continuations.

## Alibaba Token Hub, Alibaba Group

- 2026-10-14 · First author: Yujie Feng · [Evolving Together, Failing Apart: The Skill-Policy Co-evolution Trap in Self-Improving Agents](../../../agent-research/2610.20845-coda/README-en.md) (`coda`): Sections 3–4 and Appendix E retrieve once from the original bank and freeze selected IDs and retrieval-side fields. Only content is replaced; retrieving again would introduce a confound. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**

## All-Hands-AI

- 2024-07-23 · First author: Xingyao Wang · [OpenHands](../../../agent-research/2407.16741-openhands/README-en.md) (`openhands`): OpenHands is an open software agent platform. It unifies terminal, editor and browser actions in an observable event stream and isolates execution in a sandbox for bug fixes, implementation and repository maintenance.

## Amazon

- 2026-10-15 · First author: Wenxuan Ding · [Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution](../../../agent-research/2610.22466-harness-decomposition/README-en.md) (`harness-decomposition`): If the gain is not significant, attribution stops. Otherwise, construct a compute-matched baseline and an evolved variant with detected shortcuts removed. **Both controls need task-specific human review.** See Section 3. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**

## Apodex / University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign

- 2026-09-29 · First author: Cheng Qian · [Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI](../../../agent-research/2609.38143-meta-skills/README-en.md) (`meta-skills`): Distill meta-skills with when, provide and use fields from harness feedback on development tasks, then freeze the skill bank. Test tasks retrieve relevant meta-skills to build a new harness without writing test results back.

## Appier AI Research / National Taiwan University

- 2026-08-25 · First author: Zhi Rui Tam · [SMITH: Self-Improving Tool-Using Agents through Multi-Aspect Verification](../../../agent-research/2608.24571-smith/README-en.md) (`smith`): SMITH mixes build tasks that write schemas/backends from examples with held-out tasks that use the tool pool. It rewards schema validity, code execution and final outcomes separately, with harder questions encouraging reusable abstractions.

## Apple

- 2025-02-03 · First author: Kevin Chen · [LOOP](../../../agent-research/2502.01600-loop/README-en.md) (`loop`): LOOP combines PPO's trust region with a leave-one-out baseline so it can update repeatedly on a batch without a critic. Token-level importance-ratio clipping limits drifting tokens without discarding whole long trajectories.

## Aston University

- 2026-08-26 · First author: Songyuan Li · [ProgRouter: Online Progress-Guided Orchestration for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows under Quality-Cost Tradeoffs](../../../agent-research/2608.25992-progrouter/README-en.md) (`progrouter`): A dual-path predictor estimates the marginal progress each candidate model would yield. A meta-gate makes stepwise routing decisions under quality, time, and long-run cost budgets.

## Authors did not disclose affiliation

- 2026-08-17 · First author: Huan Zhang · [TRCA: Transition-wise Rubric Credit Assignment for Long-horizon LLM Agents](../../../agent-research/2608.16156-trca/README-en.md) (`trca`): Without successful anchors, derive base and breakthrough rewards for each transition from evidence, execution and invalidity rubrics.
- 2026-08-12 · First author: Zhixin Zhang · [LoongReflect: Boosting Long-Horizon Reflection in Search Agents via Global Perspective Distillation](../../../agent-research/2608.11967-loongreflect/README-en.md) (`loongreflect`): Treat reflect and backtrack as memory-control actions on a reversible trajectory tree. Coordinate fast privileged-teacher supervision with slower outcome GRPO.
- 2026-08-04 · First author: Xiuhui You · [ToolLIFT: Lifting Tool-Specific Trajectories into Function-Level Graphs for Generalizable Tool Planning](../../../agent-research/2608.03468-toollift/README-en.md) (`toollift`): Lift tool-specific histories into a transferable function workflow graph and separate workflow planning from concrete tool selection.

## Baidu

- 2026-08-24 · First author: Zixuan Wang · [Agent-G²: Gaussian Guidance for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](../../../agent-research/2608.23318-agent-g2/README-en.md) (`agent-g2`): A fixed depth ignores task difficulty; per-example probes waste rollouts. Agent-G² estimates the center and variance of a guidance band for each difficulty cluster from existing policy rollouts, then samples a prefix depth per task.

## Baidu Inc.

- 2026-07-30 · First author: Binbin Zheng · [Group-Reflective Self-Distillation](../../../agent-research/2607.28076-grsd/README-en.md) (`grsd`): Final reward mixes useful actions, repeated errors, and chance. The policy reflects on verified on-policy traces for one prompt; a stop-gradient snapshot with the same parameters contrasts success/failure reflections to form training-only DO/AVOID guidance and modulates turn-level advantages.

## Beihang University

- 2026-10-15 · First author: Huan Zhang (co-first author(s): Mingju Chen) · [RSIFlow: Adaptive Self-Improvement Workflows with an Evolving Meta-Agent](../../../agent-research/2610.21791-rsiflow/README-en.md) (`rsiflow`): Meta-model parameters remain fixed. The local component follows the released skill-memory variant and does not turn it into a system for arbitrary code self-modification. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- 2026-09-29 · First author: Mengkun Liang · [UpliftMem: Learning Set-Level Uplift for Agent Memory Retrieval](../../../agent-research/2609.36805-upliftmem/README-en.md) (`upliftmem`): Learn complementarity, redundancy, and conflict at set level. When exhaustive rollouts are impractical, use expected value of sample information (EVSI) under a correlated Gaussian posterior to probe the sets most likely to change the local retrieval decision.
- 2026-09-28 · First author: Haodong Zhu · [GraphHCA: Closed-Form Hindsight Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon LLM Agents](../../../agent-research/2609.35084-graphhca/README-en.md) (`graphhca`): GraphHCA merges rollouts into a state-transition graph and solves a discounted fixed point with success/failure terminal boundaries. Differences in log potential give step credit, normalized among actions from the same state.
- 2026-09-15 · First author: Yunxiang Zhang · [RepoAtlas: Guiding Coding Agents via Evolving Multimodal Repository Views](../../../agent-research/2609.16936-repoatlas/README-en.md) (`repoatlas`): Under a fixed budget, select a relevant code subgraph, project it into a visual topology and exact text index, and refresh both views as the task evolves.
- 2026-08-06 · First author: Xingyu Guo · [Contextual Information Policy Optimization for Search Agents](../../../agent-research/2608.06128-cipo/README-en.md) (`cipo`): **Topic: search-agent RL.** Rewarding only the final answer can reduce retrieval to confirmation bias. CIPO identifies later actions influenced by external evidence, gives dense turn-level credit, and jointly optimizes it with global outcome reward.

## Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

- 2026-08-27 · First author: Yufei Sun · [SPT: Skills as Pre-Training Data for Agentic Language Models](../../../agent-research/2608.26563-spt/README-en.md) (`spt`): Skill packages encode reusable workflows. Mid-train a causal LM on SkillCorpus before post-training; Reference Insert places cited files near first use.
- 2026-07-28 · First author: Yu Hao · [HiSkill](../../../agent-research/2607.25853-hiskill/README-en.md) (`hiskill`): Organize experience into high-level skills, executable AtomicOps, and typed directed edges. Retrieve only a task-relevant subgraph for action grounding.

## ByteDance / Duke University

- 2026-10-15 · First author: Yufa Zhou · [Athanor: An Agent-Native System for Autonomous Post-Training Research](../../../agent-research/2610.21055-athanor/README-en.md) (`athanor`): The team shares experiment records and models and combines SFT, RL, model merging, and self-distillation. Calls to external teachers are prohibited. **Not reproduced due to cost (review complete); research material only, no executable entry.**

## ByteDance Seed

- 2025-04-15 · First author: Jiazhan Feng · [ReTool](../../../agent-research/2504.11536-retool/README-en.md) (`retool`): Alternate natural-language reasoning and executable tool actions. Use execution feedback to learn tool invocation, correction and stopping.

## CASIA

- 2026-07-28 · First author: Siyu Xia · [UniMem](../../../agent-research/2607.26017-unimem/README-en.md) (`unimem`): Novel tasks first enter an episodic buffer. A self-routing controller consolidates recurring and reliable execution patterns into scalable parametric memory.

## Capital One AI Foundations

- 2026-08-11 · First author: Zelei Cheng · [Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agentic Tasks](../../../agent-research/2608.10357-sinkflex-rl/README-en.md) (`sinkflex-rl`): SinkFlex-RL combines a Gymnasium dual-control environment, VERL-style data flow, GRPO without a value model, and sink-aware FlexAttention. Causal and sliding-window masks retain the model-specific sink scaling.

## Carnegie Mellon University

- 2026-08-26 · First author: Jiarui Yan · [TraceML: An Empirical Analysis of Human-Agent Planning in Machine Learning Development](../../../agent-research/2608.26086-traceml/README-en.md) (`traceml`): TraceML records each code version, score, action intent, edit size, and impact in a unified format, comparing 4465 human trajectories with agent trajectories. It distills how humans alternate stages and reopen previous approaches into a planning prior.
- 2023-03-30 · First author: Aman Madaan · [Self-Refine](../../../agent-research/2303.17651-self-refine/README-en.md) (`self-refine`): One LLM writes a draft, produces actionable task-specific feedback, and revises until feedback says the constraints are met. No weight updates, extra training data, human feedback or external reward model.
- 2022-11-18 · First author: Luyu Gao · [PAL](../../../agent-research/2211.10435-pal/README-en.md) (`pal`): LLMs can decompose a task but make arithmetic or symbolic execution mistakes. PAL synthesizes a program with variables and control flow, then uses a deterministic runtime such as Python for exact calculation.

## Chengdu Institute of Computer Applications, Chinese Academy of Sciences

- 2026-09-10 · First author: Ruiqing Yue · [Ecdysis: Efficient and Effective Training of Runtime Harnesses for LLM Agents](../../../agent-research/2609.11677-ecdysis/README-en.md) (`ecdysis`): Aggregate recurring failures across tasks to distinguish one-off model mistakes from systematic harness defects. Multi-role FDCR diagnosis turns those patterns into repair specifications.

## Chinese University of Hong Kong

- 2026-10-11 · First author: Fan Zhang · [RSIPO: Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning via Skill-Policy Co-Evolution](../../../reproductions/2610.15772-rsipo/README-en.md) (`rsipo`): Static or offline-trained skills may not keep up with an improving policy, and a skill-augmented teacher can underperform its student. RSIPO produces skills from current-policy trajectories, measures their benefit with independent controls and matched initial-state replay, and jointly optimizes skill generation, RLVR, and self-distillation weighted by empirical-Bayes reliability. **Not reproduced for now due to cost; validation pending, no executable entry.**

## City University of Hong Kong

- 2026-08-27 · First author: Junjie Zhang · [RedEvoAgent: Automatic Red-Teaming Agent with Experience-Driven Skill Evolution](../../../agent-research/2608.27439-redevoagent/README-en.md) (`redevoagent`): Distill cross-case experience into readable skills rather than retrieving long attack traces. Attribute only decisive tools and promote skills only if held-out validation beats the incumbent.

## Columbia University / Amazon internship

- 2026-11-10 · First author: Kaiyuan Hou · [ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows](../../../agent-research/2611.14492-retrace/README-en.md) (`retrace`): ReTrace extracts conditions and argument provenance from reasoning and tool traces, merges cited rules and synthesizes executable workflows. ## Cornell University

- 2026-07-30 · First author: MaoXun Huang · [MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems](../../../agent-research/2607.28527-manta/README-en.md) (`manta`): Initialize communication topology from task priors and monitor collaboration traces. ## Cribl AI

- 2026-10-08 · First author: Babak Barazandeh · [OnTrack: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention in LLM Agent Trajectories via Streaming Structure-Aware Optimal Transport](../../../agent-research/2610.12375-ontrack/README-en.md) (`ontrack`): OnTrack forms a dependency graph from events and aligns the current execution prefix to successful reference trajectories with unbalanced, structure-aware optimal transport. Without references it explicitly falls back to loop, retry and information-stagnation detection.

## DeepWisdom

- 2023-08-01 · First author: Sirui Hong · [MetaGPT](../../../agent-research/2308.00352-metagpt/README-en.md) (`metagpt`): MetaGPT encodes human software-team SOPs as role-based message flows. Each role produces structured intermediates for downstream roles to consume and verify.

Davidson · [Reasoning-Driven Synthetic Data Generation and Evaluation](../../../agent-research/2603.29791-simula/README-en.md) (`simula`): The semantic generator and critics determine data quality and cannot be replaced by heuristics in a reproduction claim. - 2026-10-15 · First author: Weiting Liu · [GACC-Bench: Benchmarking Goal-Adaptive Context Compression Ability across Large Language Models](../../../agent-research/2610.21893-gacc-bench/README-en.md) (`gacc-bench`): A fixed reader answers each question from the same compressed memory, then a fixed judge scores against the original source and references.
